title: Presales Solutions Architect - GSI (NJ)
location: All, New Jersey, United States of America
description_html: Presales Solutions Architect - GSI (NJ)          This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:        We are seeking a  Principal Solution Architect  to support our growing Global System Integrator (GSI) business in the U.S., with a primary focus on observability and the broader Hybrid Cloud and Cloud Operations portfolio. In this highly customer- and partner-facing presales role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping GSIs architect, position, and deliver solutions that address complex customer business and technology requirements.   The ideal candidate brings strong observability expertise, proven presales experience, and experience working within the GSI ecosystem. You will combine technical depth with consultative selling skills to lead architecture discussions, develop solution strategies, support active opportunities, and help customers and partners modernize their IT operations. This role is based in New Jersey.     Responsibilities:     Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Global System Integrators, customers, sales teams, and technology partners throughout the sales cycle.  Lead architecture discussions, solution design workshops, technical strategy sessions, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept activities.  Architect solutions with a primary focus on enterprise observability and Cloud Operations, including infrastructure, application, network, and cloud environments.  Support solution architectures spanning observability, hybrid and multi-cloud, virtualization, cloud management platforms, and software-defined networking.  Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures and clearly communicate the business value of proposed solutions.  Support the positioning and adoption of HPE OpsRamp and the broader HPE Cloud Operations portfolio, including HPE Morpheus and HPE VM Essentials.  Work closely with GSI partners to strengthen their technical knowledge, solution capabilities, and ability to position HPE solutions with their customers.  Conduct executive-level technical discussions, presentations, roadmap sessions, and architecture workshops.  Support presales activities including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposals, technical presentations, and active deal progression.  Identify opportunities for expansion, cross-selling, and increased solution adoption within partner and customer environments.  Collaborate across sales, consulting, engineering, delivery, support, and other technical teams to develop comprehensive customer solutions.  Provide technical leadership and guidance across geographically distributed teams and share knowledge and best practices within the Presales community.  Maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends, competitive solutions, and evolving customer requirements.      Education and Experience:     Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent technical experience.  12+ years of technical experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, solution architecture, technical consulting, or related disciplines preferred. Candidates with fewer years may be considered based on the depth and relevance of their experience.  4+ years of relevant experience working within or closely supporting Global System Integrators (GSIs).  Proven presales or technical solution-selling experience in complex enterprise technology environments.  Strong experience with enterprise observability technologies and architectures.  Experience designing and positioning complex enterprise technology solutions for large customers and partners.  Experience engaging with senior technical, business, and executive stakeholders.  Experience working across geographically distributed teams and supporting complex customer or partner environments.  Relevant industry technology certifications are preferred.      Knowledge and Skills:     Deep knowledge of enterprise observability and AIOps concepts, including monitoring, analytics, event correlation, automation, metrics, logs, traces, topology, and telemetry.  Experience with observability technologies such as HPE OpsRamp, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, Elastic, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or comparable platforms.  Knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and cloud management platforms.  Experience with technologies such as HPE Morpheus, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, VMware Aria, or comparable cloud management and automation platforms.  Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as HPE VM Essentials, VMware vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix AHV, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM, or comparable technologies.  Knowledge of software-defined networking, enterprise networking, SD-WAN, network security, micro-segmentation, routing and switching, and network automation.  Familiarity with automation and modern infrastructure technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, REST APIs, Kubernetes, Docker, and OpenShift.  Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, solution design, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept development.  Excellent customer-facing communication, presentation, whiteboarding, storytelling, and consultative problem-solving skills.  Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.  Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer outcomes and business value.  Ability to influence and lead across customers, partners, and internal teams without direct authority.  Strong self-direction and ability to operate independently in a geographically distributed organization.  Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and apply that knowledge in customer and partner engagements.        Accessibility    HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked  here . description_html: Presales Solutions Architect (Channel) - CA          This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description:         HPE CloudOps Suite  is a comprehensive, AI-driven platform that empowers organizations to seamlessly manage, monitor, and optimize their hybrid and multi-cloud environments with unprecedented visibility and control. Built on a foundation of industry-leading solutions, including OpsRamp for intelligent monitoring and incident management, Morpheus Enterprise for hybrid cloud orchestration and automation, Morpheus VM Essentials for virtualized infrastructure, and Zerto for data protection and disaster recovery, the suite delivers unified operations management across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud resources. By combining advanced machine learning capabilities with these proven technologies, HPE Cloud Operations Suite enables IT teams to proactively identify and resolve issues, optimize performance and costs, ensure business continuity, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives while reducing operational complexity and risk across their entire technology stack.   We are seeking a  Channel Presales Solutions Architect  to drive technical enablement and solution design with our strategic partner ecosystem. You will work directly with partners to architect and implement complex solutions, guide them through deployments, and ensure successful customer outcomes across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. This role requires deep technical expertise combined with exceptional partner relationship management skills to accelerate joint go-to-market initiatives. The ideal candidate will serve as the technical bridge between HPE and our partners, driving mutual business success through innovative solution delivery and technical excellence.         Key Responsibilities:     Develop compelling customer proposals that align with business and technical needs.  Provide technical expertise in  virtualization  (VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM) and infrastructure solutions.  Support partner sales teams with solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept setups, and technical presentations.  Identify business opportunities through partner engagements, upselling, and cross-selling.  Collaborate with internal teams and partners to design cost-effective, scalable solutions.  Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor offerings to refine HPE’s value proposition.  Document and track partner activities, contributing to forecasting and pipeline management.  Act as a trusted advisor, addressing partner concerns and ensuring technical solutions align with their IT ecosystem.        Qualifications & Experience:     Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.   5-10 years  of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical selling.  Proven track record in solution configurations and architecture design, particularly in virtualization  (VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM).   Experience with solution designs for Aria Operations and/or Aria Automation  Basic knowledge of Linux/Windows OS deployments, networking (VLANs, routing, virtual switching), and storage (SAN/NAS, iSCSI, software-defined storage).  Hands-on experience with  hypervisors  and  automation tools  (PowerShell, Bash, etc.).  Industry certifications in  virtualization  and  IT infrastructure  (preferred).        Skills & Competencies:     Strong technical selling, consultative engagement, and presentation skills.  Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers, partners, and stakeholders.  Knowledge of  HPE’s hardware and software portfolio , including basic hybrid IT solutions, and how it compares to competitors in terms of performance, innovation, market positioning, and value proposition.  Problem-solving mindset with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects.  Understanding of  channel programs and partner collaboration  to drive deals effectively.         Knowledge and Skills:     Intermediate-level written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages (both in-person and virtual) as needed to perform job requirements.  Demonstrates intermediate discussion and persuasion skills, competitive differentiation (vs. VMware, etc.), and the ability to handle objections. Applies consultative selling tactics to align solutions with customer business outcomes.  Intermediate-level business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage—with an awareness of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles.  Intermediate consultative and value selling skills, including presenting, white-boarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.  Hands-on experience with relevant hypervisors, OS platforms, and basic scripting/automation (PowerShell, Bash, etc.) to support demos and solutions.    Hands-on experience with IT operations frameworks and solutions like OpsRamp, Aria Operations, or Dynatrace.  Adept at prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, and performing due diligence on customer solutions. Skilled in problem-solving with a methodical, analytical approach.  Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk-throughs of products, solutions, tools or services to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.  Intermediate-level knowledge of partner offerings, channel programs, and the company’s go-to-market approach. Able to collaborate with resellers to drive deals and leverage partner capabilities effectively.  Familiarity with SAN/NAS, iSCSI, or software-defined storage and how these relate to virtualization.  Understanding of VLANs, basic routing, and virtual switching concepts.
